# acecloud_vpcs (Data Source)

List all VPCs in the current region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "acecloud_vpcs" "all" {}

output "all_vpc_names" {
  value = [for v in data.acecloud_vpcs.all.vpcs : v.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `vpcs` (Attributes List) List of VPCs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpcs))

<a id="nestedatt--vpcs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpcs`

Read-Only:

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Administrative state of the VPC.
- `id` (String) VPC UUID.
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum transmission unit of the VPC network.
- `name` (String) VPC name.
- `router_external` (Boolean) Whether the VPC is an external (public) network.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the VPC is shared across projects.
- `status` (String) VPC status (e.g. ACTIVE, BUILD).
